title: Constant functions are exponential-polynomial
statement: For every $A\in\mathbb{N}$, the constant function $n\mapsto A$ is exponential-polynomial: there exist $K,k\in\mathbb{N}$ such that $A\le 2^{K(n+1)^k}$ for every $n\in\mathbb{N}$.
